name: brisk
description: Assesses Claude's code changes after every turn and says when a person should look too, with the questions to think about. Before a push, runs one agent review guided by brisk's plan and asks a person in the permission prompt when brisk says so.

binary.title: brisk binary
binary.description: A command name looked up on PATH (skipping relative entries and entries inside the project), or an absolute or ~/ path outside the project. Needs brisk v0.2.0 or later.

base.title: Base ref
base.description: Ref to compare the working tree against. Empty: the merge base with origin/HEAD, else main, else master.

agent_review.title: Agent review
agent_review.description: before-push: the first push of each version of the changes is held back while Claude runs a review guided by brisk's plan. after-turn: also starts that review when Claude's turn ends. off: no review.

ask_person.title: Ask a person
ask_person.description: When brisk asks for a person: ask (show the questions after the turn, and ask in the permission prompt before a push), note (show the questions only), or off.

confirm_unassessed.title: Confirm unassessed pushes
confirm_unassessed.description: Ask a person before a push when brisk could not assess the changes.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Lets TypeSafe's Jev answer brisk's questions through OpenRouter. Each new version of the changes costs one or two calls. Empty: OPENROUTER_API_KEY from the environment, else rules only.
